summary: TASK-0021 evidence is mostly present, but the drift report does not satisfy criterion 4 because it does not clearly distinguish implemented, partially implemented, duplicate, and dead paths.

criteria.criterion: A machine-readable component inventory covers every default-visible package, command, Skill, adapter, contract family, active architecture document, and active task.
criteria.notes: Inventory contains 74 entries covering package scripts, commands, local Skills, adapter, component, contract-family, architecture/policy/ADR document, task-record, and active-task categories. Index files were treated as navigation indexes rather than architecture concept documents.

criteria.criterion: Each inventory entry names owner, lifecycle class, entrypoints, consumers, tests, served Core Objects, and replacement/removal information.
criteria.notes: Verifier field audit found no inventory entries missing owner, lifecycle_class, entrypoints, consumers, tests, served_core_objects, or replacement_or_removal.

criteria.criterion: Baseline command results and environment limitations are preserved as Evidence.
criteria.notes: Verifier reran baseline checks: scripts/check.py passed 70 tests, lint_awkp returned 0 errors and warnings, and git diff --check reported no whitespace errors.

criteria.criterion: A drift report distinguishes implemented, partially implemented, documented-only, duplicate, and dead paths.
criteria.notes: task-drift-report.json combines partially implemented and implemented into one classification and does not explicitly classify duplicate or dead paths inside the drift report. The duplicate master-plan limitation appears in implementation-report.json, but the acceptance criterion requires the drift report itself to distinguish those categories.

criteria.criterion: TASK-0011 through TASK-0020 have append-only, human-direction-consistent reconciliation outcomes; no history is rewritten.
criteria.notes: Verifier compared TASK-0011 through TASK-0020 events against HEAD; each current ledger preserved all prior lines and appended exactly one backlog_reconciled event with the recorded decision.

criteria.criterion: No file is deleted and no new runtime behavior is introduced.
criteria.notes: git status and git ls-files --deleted showed no deleted files. The only tracked code edit is scripts/lint_awkp.py, scoped to ignoring non-authoritative work/proposed task drafts during doc frontmatter linting, not runtime execution behavior.

criteria.criterion: Proposed task IDs are confirmed or remapped atomically.
criteria.notes: Verifier checked TASK-0021 through TASK-0032 were absent in HEAD before this uncommitted promotion, and current task directories contain the required task/state/event/manifest/handoff scaffolding.

commands.notes: Verifier rerun passed: lint_contracts OK and unittest discovery ran 70 tests OK.
Verifier rerun returned AWKP lint: 0 error(s), 0 warning(s).

commands.command: manifest SHA-256 audit for TASK-0021 artifact/evidence manifests
commands.notes: All local artifact and evidence manifest hashes matched file content.

commands.command: component inventory field and entrypoint audit
commands.notes: No required fields were missing; pyproject scripts and local Skill directories were represented.
Each old task appended exactly one backlog_reconciled event relative to HEAD.
Each promoted task directory was absent in HEAD and is present in the current worktree.
task-drift-report.json lacks distinct implemented, partially implemented, duplicate, and dead-path categories.
